description:
A small Windows companion for WSL.

WSLPad is a Windows tray companion that makes hidden WSL state visible. It includes a dashboard, a dual-pane Windows and WSL file explorer, an interactive terminal, a step-by-step VHDX relocation wizard, and a read-only MCP server. Recovery commands are prepared for review and are never run automatically.
WSLPad 1.0.1 adds real Windows drive detection, truthful disk headroom calculations, folder explorer navigation, and strict verification gates ensuring prior steps are verified before advancing.
